newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK IONIAN BANK TO CUT DEPO, LOAN RATES.
newsitem.headline: GREEK IONIAN BANK TO CUT DEPO, LOAN RATES.

text.p: Greek state Ionian Bank will slash its base lending rates for working capital and fixed assets by 175 basis points to 15.75 percent effective March 3, the bank said in a statement.

It also slashed its "priviliged" lending rates for working capital and fixed assets by 175 basis points to 14.25 percent, its consumer loan rates by 75 basis points and its credit card rates by 100 basis points to 25 percent from March 3.
Ionian will also cut its base savings rate by 75 basis points to 9.50 percent from February 26.
